digest.component_or_area: Backend port exception contract and Jira DataCenter transport
propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError but core reconciler catch clauses only handle urllib.error.HTTPError, causing soft-degradation and deletion-detection to fail on DC backends.

BackendHTTPError must be declared as a neutral exception contract on the port, subclassing urllib.error.HTTPError to preserve HTTP status codes and maintain compatibility with existing Cloud transport paths.
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary, preserving the HTTP status code so existing core exception handlers work without modification.
Deletion detection in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue must classify DC 404 responses as _DELETED and other DC errors as _TRANSPORT_ERROR, driven through the real function logic.
The soft-degradation handler in dispatch_apply_phases._update_one_apply_reporter must catch DC 4xx errors and record outbound-reporter-not-permitted instead of allowing exceptions to escape.
No modifications to dispatch_apply_phases.py or outbound_differ.py are required; the subclass relationship makes the fix work by construction without touching live-validated Cloud code paths.
